audit.why: packet.levelChart is Skill / Wukong / Wukong / Skill / Skill / Wukong / Wukong and both phases[N].side and win[N] already match it row for row, with the whys agreeing. No chart edits proposed.

audit.whatIsWrong: The spike text described Level 4-5 and Level 6 through invented ability names rather than what the abilities do, and the passive spike — full Determination — was never mentioned anywhere on the page.
audit.why: Riot's text: his Q makes the next attack slash twice for bonus damage and healing on 10/9/8/7/6s, his E is a 10s dash-and-slice, and his R on 110/95/80s heals him for a portion of the damage it deals. The passive stacks Determination for bonus AD and at full stacks grants increased AD and a revive — that is a real spike the page omits.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text and spikes[2].text now describe the double-slash heal, the E dash and the 110s ultimate by behaviour and cooldown; dontsFull[1].d now names the full-Determination AD and revive.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page calls Zaahen's abilities 'Darkin Glaive' (Q), 'Golden Onslaught' (E) and 'Final Retribution' (R) in early, mid, late, spikes[1], spikes[2], wants.foe[0] and wants.foe[1]. None of those names exists in the kit file — its ability entries carry no names at all and packet.enemyAbilities is null. late also says his 'W reset', but his W is a pull, not a reset. His W pull, his Q recast knock-up and his R's self-heal were never stated.
audit.why: With no name data in the kit for this champion, any name on the page is unsourced. Riot's text does give behaviour: W stabs from 850 range and pulls enemies toward him on 14s; Q can be recast so the next attack knocks up; R heals for a portion of the damage dealt. Those are the facts the advice should key on.
audit.corrected: Every invented name removed and replaced with the slot plus what it actually does, at the same length. dontsFull[0].d now states the Q-recast knock-up tell, dosFull[2].d the 850-range W pull, dosFull[0].d and breakdown.cooldowns the 110s self-healing R, and report[8].t adds Grievous Wounds since both his Q and R heal.

audit.why: packet.suspectNames flags "Warrior Trickster's" in early. Warrior Trickster is Wukong's real W. False positive; left unchanged.

edits.before: Level 1 is mutual farming with no all-in threat, then you take the lane: at 2 E Nimbus Strike into Q Crushing Blow is a complete trade he has no answer for, and at 3 the full E-Q-W rotation shreds his armor while Warrior Trickster's clone eats the E Golden Onslaught he tries to respond with.
edits.after: Level 1 is mutual farming with no all-in threat, then you take the lane: at 2 E Nimbus Strike into Q Crushing Blow is a complete trade he has no answer for, and at 3 the full E-Q-W rotation shreds his armor while Warrior Trickster's clone eats the dash-and-slice he tries to respond with.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 flatten out as he stabilises farm and both of you live on cooldown timings - his glaive poke stings, so pick trades where your E starts and his E is down. Level 6 stays even on paper: his R Final Retribution answers Cyclone if he holds it, which is exactly why you bait it with the clone before spinning for real.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 flatten out as he stabilises farm and both of you live on cooldown timings - his double-slash Q heals him every 10s at rank 1, so pick trades where your E starts and his 10s dash is down. Level 6 stays even: his R heals off the damage it deals, which is exactly why you bait it with the clone before spinning for real.

edits.before: First item hands the duel back to you - armor shred plus item burst beats his rotation in a straight fight - and two items in you stay ahead on the terms that matter: clone stealth creates picks he cannot scout, Cyclone breaks his all-in, and your double-cast re-engage finishes what his W reset tries to escape.
edits.after: First item hands the duel back to you - armor shred plus item burst beats his rotation in a straight fight - and two items in you stay ahead on the terms that matter: clone baits create picks he cannot scout, Cyclone breaks his all-in, and Grievous Wounds cuts the heal his Q and R both live on.

edits.after: His Q double-slash heal and his E dash burst come online - trade on cooldowns, not on principle, and keep the clone for his commit.
